answers.core: Yes, it's a extension of `AudioStreamPlayer2D` which will improve the artistic freedom of the engine and the implementation of this feature is very simple.
answers.workaround: No and maybe yes, it requires a combination of nodes which will need to always be checking for the distance of the player and controlling the volume of a `AudioStreamPlayer` to emulate distance attenuation, this will be however extremely limited as we can't control attenuation curves like it works with `AudioStreamPlayer2D` and we can't preview the audio max distance from the editor.

title: AudioStreamPlayer2D should be allowed to do only distance attenuation for the volume and disable panning of the stereo channels.
